cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: I Know How to Fix Us
cards.instruction: Perform confidence about repairing the relationship while improvising every step.

mechanism: A presents reconciliation as an established process but invents stages from B challenges and yields agenda control to keep B in the interaction.
confusable: Unlike merely naming progress, A must improvise an actual next step from B needs; borrowed authority converts the concession into apparent planned leadership.
comparison: Biscuit-stage improvisation and shared agenda differ from monitoring interruptions with a pen.
seedUse: Use D90-b stages/biscuit/process challenge and S02-b revising the method around participant conditions.
